CM Yogi to Inaugurate Noida Authority Headquarters and Projects

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is scheduled to visit Noida and Yamuna City to inaugurate the new Noida Authority headquarters and lay the foundation stone for several development projects. The new headquarters, located in Sector-96 near the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway, is designed with modern offices, digital facilities, and ample parking for employees and visitors. The Chief Minister will also dedicate and initiate projects worth 2478 crore rupees during his visit.
